source.citation: Sadeghi M et al. (2026), Vadose zone analytical algorithm (VZAA): a non-iterative algorithm for vadose zone soil moisture and groundwater recharge, Journal of Hydrology 673:135467

source_bound_findings.history_quantity: The VZAA flux relation uses H, a half-order time derivative of soil moisture.
source_bound_findings.published_discrete_evaluation: Equation 5 evaluates H from the soil-moisture history from the initial time to the current time by a weighted sum over all prior time intervals.
source_bound_findings.history_length_symbol: N is defined as the number of timesteps from the initial time to the current time.
source_bound_findings.flow_direction_switch: Equation 6 switches the correction factor between c_w=0.5 for H<=0 and c_d=2 for H>0 in the presented implementation.
source_bound_findings.authors_future_work: The discussion explicitly identifies efficient approximations of the half-order derivative that reduce dependence on long moisture histories as future work.

direct_published_algorithm_cost.persistent_history_if_stored_literally: O(N_elapsed_steps) soil-moisture history per required layer/history signal
direct_published_algorithm_cost.total_simulation_work_implication: can grow superlinearly with number of elapsed timesteps if the full history sum is recomputed repeatedly

SWAP5_invariant_assessment.invariant_27_optional_functionality_scal: HISTORY_COST_MUST_NOT ACCUMULATE WITHOUT A HARD BOUND

qualification_consequence.required_before_any_VZAA_derived_product: replace the unbounded history evaluation by a scientifically qualified bounded-memory/bounded-work representation of the half-order derivative, or remove/rederive that term with independent evidence

research_options_not_yet_admitted: bounded recursive or sum-of-exponentials approximation to the fractional-memory kernel

required_evidence_for_history_compressio: error against literal published history evaluation over wetting, drying and repeated reversal sequences
